title: Old Lady Leary
transcription:
Old Lady Leary

One dark night, when we were all in bed,
Old lady leary left the lantern in the shed,
and when the cow kicked it over,
she winked her eye and said,
'It'll be a hot time,
in the old town, tonight,
Fire! Fire! Fire!'
sing three times through, getting faster each
time

Additional scream optional at end of song.
